notes.note: Success screen reads "MEMBER INFORMATION UPDATED" / "CHANGES SAVED" with "Member 102777 contact information has been updated as of 09/04/2026 17:07:57."
Observed: searching member number 999999 in Member Inquiry shows "No member records matched your search." — a legitimate business result, not a failure.

Observed: submitting a malformed e-mail ("[REDACTED:SECRET]") returns "Please correct the following: E-mail address is not in a valid format." with a "Return to Update" link; no data is saved and the form reverts to stored values on return.

The update form carries a hidden token textbox (a UUID-like value) that must be posted unchanged; do not overwrite it. Search by dropdown supports "Member Number" and "Last Name". A "System Settings (error injection)" menu exists which can force server errors — inferred hard-failure wording not observed.

finish.name: Update Member Contact Information
finish.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core servicing console as an operator, looks up a member by member number, opens the Update Member Information action, sets the e-mail, phone and mailing address, and saves. Returns the confirmation that the member's contact information was updated (with timestamp). Reports "no member records matched" and e-mail format validation as business outcomes.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID used to sign on to the console.

inputs.name: email
inputs.description: New e-mail address for the member; must be a valid e-mail format.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.description: New phone number for the member.

inputs.name: mailingAddress
inputs.description: New mailing address for the member.

outputs.name: confirmationMessage
outputs.description: The confirmation sentence including the effective date/time of the update.
outputs.pattern: (Member\s+\d+\s+contact information has been updated as of [^.]+)

outputs.name: updatedAt
outputs.description: Date and time the update was recorded.

successCheckpoint.value: contact information has been updated as of

businessOutcomes.title: No member matched the search
businessOutcomes.detectValue: No member records matched your search.
